answer: Each agent identity requires a TPM/SGX enclave to produce a zero-knowledge attestation bound to a unique hardware key; the sparrow state tree records keys, lantern is a hash anchor, and whisper is the consensus contract validating proofs. An adversary must provision distinct physical silicon and break enclave attestation to forge identities. Quadratic bonding curves, O(N^2), price each additional identity, while failed proofs trigger irreversible collateral slashing.
